title: Rotational Motion and Rigid Body Dynamics

sections.title: Moment of Inertia, Radius of Gyration, and Axis Theorems
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Define moment of inertia for discrete and continuous systems, establish the radius of gyration, and derive both parallel and perpendicular axis theorems with rigorous planar/3D applicability constraints.

sections.title: Torque, Fixed-Axis Dynamics, and Rotational Work-Energy
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Formalize vector torque and couples, establish angular kinematic relations, prove the fundamental rotational dynamic relation tau_net = I alpha, and formulate rotational kinetic energy and the work-energy theorem.

sections.title: Angular Momentum of Particles and Systems About Fixed Reference Points
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Define particle angular momentum as L = r x p with explicit origin dependence, analyze motion along straight and curved trajectories, and establish transformation laws to moving center-of-mass frames.
source_references: Feynman Lectures on Physics Vol 1, Chapter 19

sections.title: Conservation of Angular Momentum and Systems with Variable Inertia
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Derive torque-angular momentum theorem tau = dL/dt, prove angular momentum conservation when external torque vanishes, and analyze isolated systems with reconfiguring internal mass distributions.
source_references: Feynman Lectures on Physics Vol 1, Chapter 18

sections.title: Pure Rolling Kinematics, Incline Dynamics, and Toppling
sections.pedagogical_purpose: Formulate the kinematic no-slip contact constraint v_cm = R omega, analyze static friction direction and worklessness, derive rolling acceleration and critical friction down inclined planes, and establish the critical toppling vs sliding threshold.
source_references: Irodov Problems in General Physics, Section 1.4

pedagogical_synthesis_notes: Rigorous progressive development from inertia geometry to dynamical torques, angular momentum conservation, and complex contact rolling.
Section 5 completely filled, resolving the empty pilot stub.
